title: Permission Protocol execution attestation, attest_v1 signed payload
description: The object encoded by attestation_artifact.payload_bytes_b64 (SPEC.md section 9). Absent fields were null in the issuer's row and are omitted from the signed bytes. Consistency rules the schema cannot express (succeeded/failed carry startedAt and finishedAt with finishedAt >= startedAt; unknown carries neither finishedAt nor outputHash) are in SPEC.md section 9.2.

approvalReceiptId.description: The id of the APPROVED receipt this attests. One attestation per receipt.

toolCallId.description: The adapter's own id for the call, when it returned one.

outputHash.description: sha256: plus lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the adapter output. Unsalted.

createdAt.description: When the issuer recorded the outcome.
